The exact all-ring Perron–Lucas/Fibonacci–Lucas decomposition, unit-leading cubic growth and nontrivial Fibonacci correction supply an infinite structural capacity theorem unavailable from generic rationality or a finite numerical table. The exact two-term exponential asymptotic is a motivated nontrivial statistic rather than a tiny parameter gain.
